body.message:
Once you have completed the check-in process, we will share the check-in details with you on the day of your arrival, usually between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM.

Our standard check-in time starts at 3:00 PM. However, if the apartment is ready earlier, we will be happy to provide you with early access as soon as it becomes available. You may then proceed with the self-check-in using the provided instructions.
